ei.subject: 영어

fullPassage: In one study, when researchers suggested that a date was associated with a new beginning (such as “the first day of spring”), students viewed it as a more attractive time to kick-start goal pursuit than when researchers presented it as an unremarkable day (such as “the third Thursday in March”). Whether it was starting a new gym habit or spending less time on social media, when the date that researchers suggested was associated with a new beginning, more students wanted to begin changes right then. And more recent research by a different team found that similar benefits were achieved by showing goal seekers modified weekly calendars. When calendars depicted the current day (either Monday or Sunday) as the first day of the week, people reported feeling more motivated to make immediate progress on their goals. Meaningful dates can thus serve as catalysts for behavioral change.

questions.passage: In one study, when researchers suggested that a date was (A)[associated / disconnected] with a new beginning (such as “the first day of spring”), students viewed it as a more (B)[attractive / repulsive] time to kick-start goal pursuit than when researchers presented it as an unremarkable day (such as “the third Thursday in March”). Whether it was starting a new gym habit or spending less time on social media, when the date that researchers suggested was associated with a new beginning, more students wanted to begin changes right then. And more recent research by a different team found that similar benefits were (C)[achieved / forfeited] by showing goal seekers modified weekly calendars. When calendars depicted the current day (either Monday or Sunday) as the first day of the week, people reported feeling more motivated to make immediate progress on their goals. Meaningful dates can thus serve as catalysts for behavioral change.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 날짜가 새로운 시작과 관련되면 학생들은 그것을 목표 추구에 더 매력적인 시기로 보았고, 비슷한 이점이 달성되었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① associated — attractive — achieved — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② disconnected — attractive — achieved (A 반대: 관련된→단절된)
❌ ③ associated — repulsive — achieved (B 반대: 매력적인→혐오스러운)
❌ ④ associated — attractive — forfeited (C 반대: 달성된→상실된)

questions.passage: In one study, when researchers (A)[suggested / denied] that a date was associated with a new beginning (such as “the first day of spring”), students viewed it as a more attractive time to kick-start goal pursuit than when researchers presented it as an unremarkable day (such as “the third Thursday in March”). Whether it was starting a new gym habit or spending less time on social media, when the date that researchers suggested was associated with a new beginning, more students wanted to begin changes right then. And more recent research by a different team found that similar benefits were achieved by showing goal seekers (B)[modified / unchanged] weekly calendars. When calendars depicted the current day (either Monday or Sunday) as the first day of the week, people reported feeling more (C)[motivated / discouraged] to make immediate progress on their goals. Meaningful dates can thus serve as catalysts for behavioral change.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 연구자들이 제안한 날짜가 새로운 시작과 관련되었고, 수정된 주간 달력을 보여주었을 때, 사람들은 더 동기 부여가 되었다고 보고했다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① denied — modified — motivated (A 반대: 제안하다→부인하다)
❌ ② suggested — unchanged — motivated (B 반대: 수정된→변경되지 않은)
❌ ③ suggested — modified — discouraged (C 반대: 동기 부여된→낙담한)
✅ ④ suggested — modified — motivated — 원문 일치 ←정답

questions.passage: In one study, when researchers suggested that a date was associated with a new beginning (such as “the first day of spring”), students viewed it as a more attractive time to kick-start goal pursuit than when researchers presented it as an (A)[unremarkable / extraordinary] day (such as “the third Thursday in March”). Whether it was starting a new gym habit or spending less time on social media, when the date that researchers suggested was associated with a new beginning, more students wanted to begin changes right then. And more recent research by a different team found that (B)[similar / contrasting] benefits were achieved by showing goal seekers modified weekly calendars. When calendars depicted the current day (either Monday or Sunday) as the first day of the week, people reported feeling more motivated to make (C)[immediate / delayed] progress on their goals. Meaningful dates can thus serve as catalysts for behavioral change.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 평범한 날로 제시했을 때보다, 비슷한 이점이 달성되었고, 사람들은 즉각적인 진전을 이루고 싶어 했다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① extraordinary — similar — immediate (A 반대: 평범한→비범한)
❌ ② unremarkable — contrasting — immediate (B 반대: 유사한→대조적인)
❌ ③ unremarkable — similar — delayed (C 반대: 즉각적인→지연된)
✅ ④ unremarkable — similar — immediate — 원문 일치 ←정답

questions.passage: In one study, when researchers ①<u>suggested</u> that a date was associated with a new beginning (such as “the first day of spring”), students viewed it as a more ②<u>attractive</u> time to kick-start goal pursuit than when researchers presented it as an ③<u>remarkable</u> day (such as “the third Thursday in March”). Whether it was starting a new gym habit or spending less time on social media, when the date that researchers suggested was associated with a new beginning, more students wanted to begin changes right then. And more recent research by a different team found that similar benefits were achieved by showing goal seekers ④<u>modified</u> weekly calendars. When calendars depicted the current day (either Monday or Sunday) as the first day of the week, people reported feeling more motivated to make immediate progress on their goals. Meaningful dates can thus serve as catalysts for behavioral change.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 새로운 시작과 관련된 날짜는 매력적이었지만, 평범한 날(unremarkable)이 아니라 '주목할 만한(remarkable)' 날로 제시하면 대조가 성립하지 않는다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① suggested — 제안했다, 원문 일치
✅ ② attractive — 매력적인, 원문 일치
❌ ③ remarkable — 원문은 unremarkable(평범한). 새로운 시작의 날과 대조되는 '평범한 날'이 맞으므로 remarkable(주목할 만한)은 부적절 ←정답
✅ ④ modified — 수정된, 원문 일치

questions.passage: In one study, when researchers suggested that a date was associated with a new ①<u>beginning</u> (such as “the first day of spring”), students viewed it as a more attractive time to kick-start goal pursuit than when researchers presented it as an unremarkable day (such as “the third Thursday in March”). Whether it was starting a new gym habit or spending less time on social media, when the date that researchers suggested was associated with a new beginning, more students wanted to begin ②<u>changes</u> right then. And more recent research by a different team found that similar ③<u>benefits</u> were achieved by showing goal seekers modified weekly calendars. When calendars depicted the current day (either Monday or Sunday) as the first day of the week, people reported feeling more ④<u>unmotivated</u> to make immediate progress on their goals. Meaningful dates can thus serve as catalysts for behavioral change.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 달력이 현재 날을 주의 첫날로 묘사했을 때, 사람들은 '의욕이 없어진(unmotivated)'이 아니라 '의욕이 생긴(motivated)'이라고 보고했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① beginning — 시작, 원문 일치
✅ ② changes — 변화, 원문 일치
✅ ③ benefits — 이점, 원문 일치
❌ ④ unmotivated — 원문은 motivated(동기 부여된). 새로운 시작 효과로 의욕이 생겼으므로 unmotivated는 부적절 ←정답

questions.passage: In one study, when researchers suggested that a date was associated with a new beginning (such as “the first day of spring”), students viewed it as a more attractive time to kick-start goal pursuit than when researchers ①<u>presented</u> it as an unremarkable day (such as “the third Thursday in March”). Whether it was starting a new gym habit or spending less time on social media, when the date that researchers suggested was associated with a new beginning, more students wanted to begin changes right then. When calendars ③<u>depicted</u> the current day (either Monday or Sunday) as the first day of the week, people reported feeling more motivated to make immediate ④<u>progress</u> on their goals. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 다른 팀의 연구에서 '유사한(similar)' 이점이 달성되었는데, '유사하지 않은(dissimilar)'이면 문맥과 맞지 않는다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① presented — 제시했다, 원문 일치
❌ ② dissimilar — 원문은 similar(유사한). 다른 팀도 같은 효과를 확인했으므로 dissimilar(유사하지 않은)는 부적절 ←정답
✅ ③ depicted — 묘사했다, 원문 일치
✅ ④ progress — 진전, 원문 일치

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 날짜가 새로운 시작과 관련되었을 때, 더 많은 학생들이 변화를 시작하고 싶어했다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① an unremarkable day — 평범한 날. 대조군이므로 빈칸에 부적합
✅ ② a new beginning — 새로운 시작. 날짜가 이와 관련될 때 학생들이 변화 원함 ←정답
❌ ③ weekly calendars — 주간 달력. 뒤 문장에서 별도로 언급되는 내용
❌ ④ immediate progress — 즉각적 진전. 결과이지 원인이 아님
det.tip: associated with a new beginning = 새로운 시작과 관련된

questions.passage: In one study, when researchers suggested that a date was associated with a new beginning (such as “the first day of spring”), students viewed it as a more attractive time to kick-start goal pursuit than when researchers presented it as an unremarkable day (such as “the third Thursday in March”). Whether it was starting a new gym habit or spending less time on social media, when the date that researchers suggested was associated with a new beginning, more students wanted to begin changes right then. And more recent research by a different team found that similar benefits were achieved by showing __________ modified weekly calendars. When calendars depicted the current day (either Monday or Sunday) as the first day of the week, people reported feeling more motivated to make immediate progress on their goals. Meaningful dates can thus serve as catalysts for behavioral change.

det.analysis:

❌ ② students — 학생. 두 번째 실험에서는 students가 아닌 일반 표현 사용
